list.name: service_filter
list.label: Service filter (L1)
list.description: Limit the recent-traces list to traces that touched this exact service name. Empty = all.

list.name: trace_search
list.label: Trace search (L1)
list.description: ILIKE on the originating span:instance:online event_message (the entry-point service name or root span name).

list.name: selected_trace
list.label: Selected trace
list.description: Set automatically by clicking a trace_id in the L1 table. Clear to hide the L2/L3 panels.

list.name: selected_service
list.label: Selected service
list.description: Set automatically by clicking a service in the L2 node graph or per-service bar chart. Clear to view logs of all services in the trace.

list.name: selected_span
list.label: Selected span
list.description: Set automatically by clicking a span row in the L2 spans table. Overrides the service filter — L3 shows only events whose span chain contains this span_id. Clear to fall back to (trace, service) scoping.

panels.title: Recent traces — click a trace_id to drill into L2/L3

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.trace_id::text AS trace_id, min(e.event_date) AS started_at, ROUND((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (max(e.event_date) - min(e.event_date))) * 1000)::numeric, 2) AS duration_ms, count(*)::bigint AS event_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type IN (13, 14, 100, 101, 102, 103, 104))::bigint AS error_count, COALESCE(string_agg(DISTINCT e.service_name, ', '), '') AS services FROM witness.events e WHERE e.trace_id IS NOT NULL AND e.event_date >= $__timeFrom()::timestamp AND e.event_date <= $__timeTo()::timestamp AND ('$service_filter' = '' OR e.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM witness.events WHERE service_name = '$service_filter' AND trace_id IS NOT NULL)) AND ('$trace_search' = '' OR e.trace_id IN (SELECT trace_id FROM witness.events WHERE event_type = 21 AND event_message ILIKE '%' || '$trace_search' || '%' AND trace_id IS NOT NULL)) GROUP BY e.trace_id ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT ts.service_name AS id, ts.service_name AS title, 'service' AS "subTitle", ts.event_count::float8 AS "mainStat", (CASE WHEN ts.error_count > 0 THEN ts.error_count::text || ' errors' ELSE ROUND((EXTRACT(epoch FROM (ts.last_event_at - ts.first_event_at)) * 1000)::numeric, 1)::text || ' ms span' END) AS "secondaryStat" FROM witness.trace_services ts WHERE ts.trace_id = (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid UNION ALL SELECT '— select trace —' AS id, 'click a row in L1' AS title, '' AS "subTitle", 0::float8 AS "mainStat", '' AS "secondaryStat" WHERE '${selected_trace}' = ''

SELECT (cse.parent_service_name || '->' || cse.child_service_name) AS id, cse.parent_service_name AS source, cse.child_service_name AS target, count(*)::float8 AS "mainStat" FROM witness.cross_service_edges cse JOIN witness.events child ON child.event_id = cse.child_event_id WHERE child.trace_id = (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid AND cse.parent_service_name IS NOT NULL AND cse.child_service_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cse.parent_service_name, cse.child_service_name UNION ALL SELECT 'placeholder'::text AS id, ''::text AS source, ''::text AS target, 0::float8 AS "mainStat" WHERE FALSE

panels.title: Per-service events in trace — click a bar to scope L3 logs

links.title: Scope L3 logs to this service

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts.service_name, ts.event_count::bigint AS events, ts.error_count::bigint AS errors FROM witness.trace_services ts WHERE ts.trace_id = (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid ORDER BY ts.first_event_at ASC

panels.title: Spans of trace — duration & parent chain

value.title: Show logs of this span in L3
Scope L3 logs to this service

targets.rawSql: WITH trace_spans AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.span_id FROM witness.events e JOIN witness.spans s USING (event_id) WHERE e.trace_id = (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid) SELECT sp.span_name, sp.service_name, sp.started_at, ROUND((EXTRACT(epoch FROM sp.duration) * 1000)::numeric, 2) AS duration_ms, sc.parent_span_id::text AS parent_span_id, sp.span_id::text AS span_id, sp.start_caller AS caller FROM witness.span_pairs sp LEFT JOIN witness.span_children sc ON sc.child_span_id = sp.span_id WHERE sp.span_id IN (SELECT span_id FROM trace_spans) ORDER BY sp.started_at ASC LIMIT 500

SELECT (e.event_date AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS time, e.event_message AS body, COALESCE(etn.event_type_name, e.event_type::text) AS level, COALESCE(e.service_name, '<unknown>') AS service, owner.span_name AS span, e.event_caller AS caller, e.event_id::text AS id, COALESCE(e.trace_id::text, '') AS trace_id, COALESCE(erj.records::text, '{}') AS labels FROM witness.events e LEFT JOIN witness.event_type_names etn USING (event_type) LEFT JOIN witness.event_records_json erj USING (event_id) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sp.span_name FROM witness.spans s JOIN witness.span_pairs sp ON sp.span_id = s.span_id WHERE s.event_id = e.event_id ORDER BY sp.started_at DESC LIMIT 1) owner ON TRUE WHERE e.trace_id = (CASE WHEN '${selected_trace}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_trace}' END)::uuid AND ('${selected_span}' = '' OR e.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM witness.spans WHERE span_id = (CASE WHEN '${selected_span}' = '' THEN '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ELSE '${selected_span}' END)::uuid)) AND ('${selected_span}' != '' OR '${selected_service}' = '' OR e.service_name = '${selected_service}') ORDER BY e.event_date ASC LIMIT 2000
